# hello paint

custom paint-by-number kits made from a photo you love, delivered as a printable
PDF or a layered procreate file. every kit is designed, checked, and finished by
a person (Megan Warren, founder and chief painter). nothing ships; kits arrive
by email, custom orders within 1 to 2 days.

- shop: https://hellopaintart.etsy.com
- brand book and assets: https://hellopaint.megan-warren.com/brand-book
- every listing image: https://hellopaint.megan-warren.com/listing-pack
- all shop copy: https://hellopaint.megan-warren.com/copy-vault
- handles: @hellopaintart on instagram, x, threads, tiktok, youtube

how it is made, honestly: the tracing and numbering are computer-assisted, by a
program Megan wrote and keeps fixing; she checks and finishes every kit by hand.
